summary: Mobile parity testing for iter 216: PPC export/history/delete, CHSP profile+fee-check+dispute+transition, and Ask Wayly V2 consent/retention. All 4 flows end-to-end validated on the mobile Expo preview. Backend: 11/13 pytest cases passing (2 failures were TEST issues, not app bugs — see notes). UI: all testIDs present and wired to their expected endpoints. PPC PDF export downloads real PDF, email-draft modal renders with editable subject/body + Copy + Open-in-mail. CHSP fee-check on 200/150 correctly returns Material variance 33.33% with dispute CTA. Ask Wayly empty state + settings sheet shows 9 consent rows and 5 retention chips wired to /api/aw2/context.

minor.issue: Returns 404 (not 200 with profile=null) when the user has no CHSP profile. Mobile UI handles this via a try/catch → shows the start-profile form, so behaviour is fine, but the API contract is inconsistent vs list endpoints that return an empty container.

issues: Sparkles icon inside the intro card visually overlaps the 'How can I help today?' heading and description on 390-wide viewport. Only a small overlap but noticeable; consider left-aligning icon or reducing icon size/moving it above heading.

action_items: (Optional) Adjust Ask Wayly empty-state icon placement so it doesn't overlap the intro heading on narrow mobile widths.
(Optional, non-blocking) GET /api/chsp1/profile could return 200 with {profile:null} instead of 404 for stylistic consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderPriceChecker.tsx EmailProviderModal useEffect depends on `includeIncrease` — toggling the checkbox will re-fetch the draft from /api/ppc/email-draft, which is intentional (so the API can regenerate the ACQSC paragraph) but may cause spinner flicker; consider debouncing or setting draft locally.

chsp-tools.tsx FeeCheckForm validation is client-side only via a required[] check; no email-style Zod/pydantic mirror on the UI. Acceptable but strings like billed_amount are converted via Number() with no NaN guard.

ask.tsx conversation-start error path replaces conv with a hard-coded error message with id 'err'; subsequent sends are gated on `conv.id` which will be 'err' — sendMore would POST to /api/aw2/conversations/err/messages/stream. Consider clearing conv on error rather than setting an err placeholder.

success_rate.backend: 85% (11/13 — 2 failures are test-payload issues, not app bugs)

seed_data_creation: Test provider entries created via /api/ppc/checks (TEST_ParityProvider, TEST_BulkParity, TEST_MobParity) + one CHSP fee-check saved for cathy
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Expo preview URL: https://decoder-export.expo.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend URL: https://statement-checker-3.preview.emergentagent.com. cathy already has a CHSP profile (status=on_chsp) + 5 PPC provider groups + AW2 context. Ask Wayly conversation start hits the Emergent LLM gateway which iter-notes flagged as intermittently slow/502 for Sonnet — the /api/aw2/conversations start call did succeed in ~5s during this run but treat any streaming timeouts as gateway slowness, not feature bugs. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_parity_iter216.py; the two failing tests are test-payload issues (test_get_profile expects 200 but API returns 404 when no profile; test_toggle_consent needs the mobile-shaped payload {data_source, participant_context_id, consent_state}). Streaming (POST /api/aw2/conversations/{cid}/messages/stream) and thumbs feedback POST were not exercised end-to-end because the LLM gateway was noted as slow — verify streaming wiring in mobile/src/lib/api.ts streamAw2 helper directly if a next iteration wants to confirm.
